name: @tachui/responsive
description: Advanced responsive design patterns and utilities for tachUI framework

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vite build && vite build --config vite.config.cjs.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node ./scripts/verify-build-artifacts.mjs
scripts.build:dev: rm -rf dist && vite build --mode development && vite build --config vite.config.cjs.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node ./scripts/verify-build-artifacts.mjs
scripts.build:prod: rm -rf dist && vite build --mode production && vite build --config vite.config.cjs.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node ./scripts/verify-build-artifacts.mjs
scripts.valid: clear && vitest run && bun run type-check && bun run lint && bun run build

author: tachUI Team
